data.name: Vault.Welcome.Description
data.value: unpwn guides you through account recovery. It does not detect malware and cannot prove that a device or account is secure.

data.name: Vault.Trusted.Title
data.value: Are you using a device you trust?

data.name: Vault.Trusted.Description
data.value: Use a different, updated device if this computer may still be controlled by an attacker. Your answer is a safety decision, not a malware scan.

data.name: Vault.Trusted.No
data.value: No, or I am not sure

data.name: Vault.Guidance.Title
data.value: Move to a safer device first

data.name: Vault.Guidance.Description
data.value: Do not enter account or vault credentials on this device. Continue unpwn on another updated computer you have good reason to trust. If you do not have one, use a trusted device to create official Windows installation media from Microsoft or installation media from your Linux distribution's official source, then consider a clean installation of the affected computer. Prefer creating the installation USB on the trusted device. A clean reinstall is a recovery measure, not proof that the device is forensically or cryptographically safe.

data.name: Vault.SafetyStopped.Description
data.value: This recovery attempt ended before a vault was created or opened. Continue only from a device you trust.

data.name: Vault.Choice.Description
data.value: The encrypted vault stores recovery progress and newly generated credentials locally. It is temporary recovery workspace, not a password manager.

data.name: Vault.Create.NonRecoverable
data.value: I understand that unpwn cannot recover a forgotten vault password.

data.name: Vault.Locked.Description
data.value: Account names, progress, notes, incident details, and generated credentials are hidden until the vault is unlocked again.

data.name: Vault.Unlocked.Description
data.value: The encrypted recovery workspace is available. The assistant will resume at a safe review point and will not assume that an external provider action succeeded.

data.name: Vault.Recent.Empty
data.value: No recent vault references are stored on this device.

data.name: Vault.Password.Guidance.Empty
data.value: Use a long, unique passphrase. Password-manager paste is supported.

data.name: Vault.Password.Guidance.Short
data.value: This password is short. Use at least 12 characters; no special composition rule is required.

data.name: Vault.Password.Guidance.Good
data.value: The password length is acceptable. A unique passphrase stored in a password manager is recommended.

data.name: Vault.Validation.PasswordTooShort
data.value: Use at least 12 characters for a new vault password.

data.name: Vault.Validation.PasswordMismatch
data.value: The password confirmation does not match.

data.name: Vault.Validation.AcknowledgementRequired
data.value: Confirm that the vault password cannot be recovered.

data.name: Vault.Result.Created.Message
data.value: The encrypted vault was created and the assistant is ready to continue.

data.name: Vault.Result.Opened.Message
data.value: The assistant resumed at a safe review point.

data.name: Vault.Result.PasswordChanged.Message
data.value: The vault data key was re-wrapped with the new password.

data.name: Vault.Result.ReferenceRemoved.Message
data.value: The vault file was not deleted.

data.name: Vault.Result.FileDeleted.Message
data.value: The selected local vault file was deleted. This does not claim forensic erasure.

data.name: Vault.Failure.InvalidInput
data.value: Review the selected path and required fields.

data.name: Vault.Failure.AlreadyExists
data.value: A vault already exists at the selected location. Choose another file or open the existing vault.

data.name: Vault.Failure.NotFound
data.value: The selected vault file was not found.

data.name: Vault.Failure.AccessDenied
data.value: The application does not have permission to access the selected location.

data.name: Vault.Failure.UnsupportedVersion
data.value: This vault version is not supported by the installed application.

data.name: Vault.Failure.AuthenticationOrIntegrity
data.value: The vault could not be unlocked. The password may be incorrect, or the vault may be damaged or modified.

data.name: Vault.Failure.IoFailure
data.value: The vault file could not be read or written safely.

data.name: Vault.Failure.CurrentVaultInUse
data.value: Lock the current vault before deleting its file.

data.name: Vault.Command.Error
data.value: The vault operation could not be completed.

data.name: Vault.Confirm.Remove.Consequence
data.value: This removes only the local recent-item reference. The vault file remains unchanged.

data.name: Vault.Confirm.Delete.Consequence
data.value: This deletes the selected file and cannot recover a forgotten password or guarantee forensic erasure.

data.name: Vault.Inactivity.Warning.Message
data.value: The recovery vault will lock at {0:t} unless activity resumes.

data.name: Vault.Inactivity.Locked.Message
data.value: Unlock the vault to resume at a safe review point.

data.name: Vault.Diagnostics.Description
data.value: Create a preview before opting in to a local export. The report contains only bounded event IDs, static messages, exception type names, and generic runtime metadata—never vault content, paths, stack traces, or source error messages.

data.name: Vault.Diagnostics.Approve
data.value: I reviewed this exact preview and choose to export it locally.

data.name: Vault.Diagnostics.CommandError
data.value: The diagnostic export could not be completed.

data.name: Vault.Diagnostics.PreviewReady.Message
data.value: Review the exact sanitized content before approving an export.

data.name: Vault.Diagnostics.Error.PreviewRequired
data.value: Create and explicitly approve the current preview before exporting.

data.name: Vault.Diagnostics.Error.AccessDenied
data.value: The application does not have permission to write the selected destination.

data.name: Vault.Diagnostics.Error.IoFailure
data.value: The diagnostic file could not be written safely. Check that the path is available and storage has free space.

data.name: Vault.Diagnostics.Exported.Message
data.value: The exact reviewed diagnostic preview was written to the selected local file. Nothing was uploaded.
